data.body: Evidence 2026-10-31 (read-only SSM, kernel journal since 2026-10-20): the box has 3 memory-limit kills of rebar-mcp, at 2026-10-23 13:23 UTC (anon-rss 3.76 GB), 2026-10-24 06:31 UTC (3.63 GB) and 2026-10-29 00:47 UTC (3.73 GB, the 9-parallel next_batch burst). There have been no kills since then, through 2026-10-31 17:55 UTC, across 9 blue-green redeploys. The live container on 2026-10-31 is rebar-mcp-39821ae000aa-8092 (limit 3,892,314,112 B, restarts=0). A rebar-health sample at 2026-10-31 00:04 UTC read 303 MB for rebar-mcp-374cc2f22b1f-8093. Each redeploy also resets resident memory, so the low reading does not show that the plateau is gone. The client-side effect of the 10-29 kill (the session stayed disconnected for 2.7 days) is filed as short-elderly-cock.
